title: Alison Greenway Art | Double Gabled Suburban Home
description: Once upon a time, nestled in the heart of a peaceful suburban neighbourhood, there stood a charming double-gabled home. This suburban haven was more than just a house; it was a place where love and memories intertwined and offered a real sense of belonging.

title: Alison Greenway Art » Bayrise Manor B & W
description: This stylish Queensland home provides character and allows you to reminisce about how others lived in the mid 1880’s when they were first created, you will find numerous other versions throughout Queensland neighbourhoods and suburbs.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Tudor Estate BW
description: Contemporary façade reminiscent of the medieval Tudor homes with fascinating details and exuding character with an air of the mystique, whimsical and castle like features. Two story home suggesting a privileged lifestyle with a series of timber French doors opening up onto small balconies, allowing residents to view the formal gardens and long driveway.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Double Gabled Suburban Home Sepia
description: Displaying a thriving colourful garden tended to by the loving hands of the family living within, the slatted balustrade and staircase leading to the front porch and the traditional timber fence.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Bayrise Manor Sepia
description: This stylish Queensland home provides character and allows you to reminisce about how others lived in the mid 1880’s when they were first created, you will find numerous other versions throughout Queensland neighbourhoods and suburbs. These traditional highset homes provide natural airflow beneath and around the house and via the decorative windows and generous verandas.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Tudor Estate Sepia
description: Contemporary façade reminiscent of medieval Tudor homes, showcasing captivating details and exuding distinctive character with an aura of mystique and whimsical charm, reminiscent of castle-like features. This two-story home embodies a lifestyle of privilege, featuring a series of timber French doors that open onto quaint balconies, offering residents enchanting views of formal gardens and a picturesque long driveway.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Home Among the Gumtrees Colour
description: This stately home providing shelter for a busy but active family, and possibly been passed down through the generations – sharing many secrets and wonderful experiences.

title: Alion Greenway Art | Bayrise Manor Colour
description: Discover the allure of this Queensland home, steeped in history and character from the 1880s era. Reflect on the lifestyles of yesteryears while exploring its timeless charm. Traditional highset design ensures natural airflow beneath and around the house, complemented by ornate windows and spacious verandas. Experience a slice of Queensland's architectural heritage in this stylish abode.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Tudor Estate Colour
description: Modern exterior inspired by classic Tudor architecture, showcasing captivating intricacies and a distinct charm, evoking a sense of enchantment and grandeur reminiscent of a castle. This two-story residence embodies luxury living, boasting timber French doors that lead to quaint balconies, offering picturesque views of the manicured gardens and expansive driveway.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Maple Grove - Timber Vista Cottage BW
description: You can just imagine the residents being a young family raising their children in this comfortable home, lots of laughter, love, fun, home cooked meals and action.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Louvered Cottage B & W
description: Residing in a traditional highset Queenslander dwelling, John, the Fly-in Fly-out mine worker, values his privacy during his days off. Closed louvers offer the seclusion he seeks as he relaxes after enduring lengthy shifts at the mine site.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Jills Getaway BW
description: The house avails itself of cool breezes and ventilation beneath the floor, acting as a natural cooler on the hot summer days. A cosy cottage for Jill to reside in, as she tends to her hobbies of gardening and sitting on the verandah with a wine as she watches her neighbours passing by.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Maple Grove Cottage Sepia
description: Life in this quaint Queensland timber low-set home with bay window and gable over the living room, offers timeless charm and a unique living experience for those who love to link style and old world together.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Jills Getaway Sepia
description: The dwelling harnesses refreshing breezes and airflow beneath its foundation, serving as a built-in cooling system during scorching summer days. It's a charming abode tailored for Jill's passions: nurturing her garden and unwinding on the veranda with a glass of wine, enjoying the sight of her neighbors strolling by.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Louvered Cottage Sepia
description: Living in a basic highset Queenslander home, resides John the Fly-in Fly-out mine worker. Looking for privacy as he rests on his days off – closed louvers providing the privacy he likes as he unwinds from long shifts on the mine site.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Jills Getaway Colour
description: Jill enjoys a wine and a good book when she sits on the verandah of this quaint cottage, it provides a peaceful atmosphere with its gardens and birds singing in the trees. Jill’s getaway is a modest version of the Queenslander with its timber-framed structure, elevated above the ground on stumps ideal for the sloping block in her street.

title: Alison Greenway Art | A Little Treasure Colour
description: A Little Treasure.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Louvered Cottage Colour
description: In a traditional highset Queenslander residence, you'll find John, a Fly-in Fly-out mine worker. Seeking solace during his downtime, he appreciates the seclusion offered by closed louvers, allowing him to relax after arduous shifts on the mine site.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Toucan in the Jungle
description: The toucan, with its strikingly large and vividly coloured beak, perches gracefully on a sturdy branch, surrounded by an array of vivid green leaves and tropical flowers. The jungle, alive with the hum of insects and the calls of unseen creatures.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Old Melbourne Inn
description: The Rustic Rendition of a holiday of long ago. This acrylic painting depicts a charming brown brick wall and the staircase of the Old Melbourne Inn, a picturesque setting where well known singers and entertainers stayed when on tour.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Celebrations of Spring
description: Spring flowers grace the garden with an exquisite palette of colours. Petals unfold in shades of pastel pinks and yellows, vibrant oranges and lush greens.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Quiet Time by the Pond
description: Sitting by a quiet, secluded pond is an enchanting experience that engages the senses and offers a tranquil escape from the bustle of daily life.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Pine Haven Retreat
description: Towering pine trees stand proudly, their emerald green needles reaching towards the sky, casting a comforting shade over the landscape.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Wisteria Cottage
description: Wisteria plants, their cascading lavender blossoms hanging delicately from the trellis, lending a touch of enchantment to the scene. The sweet fragrance of the wisteria drifts through the air, creating an atmosphere of serenity and nostalgia.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Black Cockatoo
description: Being a nature lover which includes having an interest in all native animals and birds I felt a desire to paint this beautiful black Cockatoo when after I found one hiding in amongst the foliage of the Gum Tree in my local park. An unusual sighting as they tend to live in Central and Western Australia – not Queensland.

title: Alison Greenway At | Weekend Retreat
description: Dreaming of your time to relax and unwind after a long week, all you need now is a tall cold drink. How many times during summer do you day dream whilst at work, thinking of the weekend and relaxing by the pool with your friends or possibly a good book. The bright yellow umbrellas and bright day beds are calling you, the aqua coloured water enticing you to dive in and wash away all the stress from the past week.

title: Alison Greenway Art | African Highlight
description: Exotic bold glimpse of African culture. This artwork blends the beauty of the zebra stripes with a tale from African culture. A tale were single tribal women dress in exotic woven gowns to attend the annual ‘coming out’ ceremony and ritual. An event were young women hopefully find their mate for ongoing support and eventually marriage.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Sunday Morning
description: A restful morning on a rainy Sunday in Queensland. Wondering bare footed along the wooden veranda overlooking the tropical gardens. Not a care in the world as you listen to the birds and feel the misty rain on your skin on this quiet Sunday morning.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Spring Garden
description: A spring garden with staircase leading to nowhere. A painting that can transport you from hectic daily routine to a relaxed and whimsical frame of mind, as you relax with your wine and ponder on where the staircase might take you.  You can also  loose yourself in the spring garden as you wonder along the pathway and imagine what lays beyond. Vivid colours with flowering wisteria plants dangling across the frame allow you to create your own retreat - a place to loose yourself in.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Follow The Path
description: Loose yourself as you imagine what is beyond the dark pathway. Enjoy the spring colours in the garden, vivid oranges pinks and yellows. A happy time to spend with friends and family as you wonder through and smell the blossoms.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Spring Time
description: Bold coloured flowers depicting the freshness of Spring. A perfect day when you take time to enjoy the bright flowers and multiple green leaves of Spring.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Relaxing In The Study
description: Looking through the window of the home study. A place where you can escape the usual daily routine, and spend a rainy day reading and relaxing. The home study is creates a comfortable place to loose yourself in between the pages of a good book.

title: Alison Greenway Art | Amongst The Reeds
description: Peace and tranquility, as the fish swim by. Colourful and happy painting depicting clown fish peacefully swimming by, through the cool lime green colour reeds and the water with aqua tones.

title: Alison Greenway At | Underwater
description: Going with the Flow in a Tropical World. Busy life as the fish travel along in their groups, in this colourful tropical underworld.
